svg.title: .SYSTEMX — AGENT 1 detailed field guide
svg.desc: Agent 1 reviews security evidence with 400 questions and a names-only environment inventory, then provides advisory recommendations. This image also lists the exact folder, example prompt, CLI surfaces, five or six process steps, and role boundary.
svg.text: Review security evidence and inventory .env names only.
Suggest rotations; do not print credential values.
Twenty categories and ten event buckets yield advisory findings.
Actions is disabled here. No device-clean claim or live secret write is made.
